intro: Choose a program, assign its team member and review the dates before saving.
noPrograms: Create an active program for a class you can teach before scheduling sessions.
noStaff: No active team member is assigned to this class.
assignStaff: Assign staff on the class page
timezone: All times are Algeria local time (24-hour format).
repeatHint: One session per week on the same weekday. The first session counts toward the total.
conflictNotice: This is a date preview, not an availability check. The database validates class and staff conflicts when you save the complete series.
previewHint: Choose a valid date and 1 to 16 occurrences to see every session.

validation.program: Choose an active program for a class you can teach.
validation.staff: Choose a team member assigned to this class.
validation.title: Enter a title between 1 and 200 characters.
validation.kind: Choose a session type suitable for this class.
validation.range: The first session must fall within the program dates.
validation.time: Choose a valid time in 24-hour format.
validation.order: End time must be later than start time on the same day.
validation.weeks: Enter a whole number from 1 to 16.
validation.recurrence: Every session must fall within the program dates. Change the first date or reduce the number of weeks.
